# LinkButton

Link button: navigates, and looks like a button. It renders an anchor, so it has no disabled or loading state. Props follow Atlassian's Link button (https://atlassian.design/components/button/link-button).

**Import:** `import { LinkButton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, Spacing, WithIcons, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.mdx`
